description: Internal district boundaries - Department of Transport and Main Roads - Queensland is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. District boundaries for Program Delivery and Operations with Qld Department of Transport and Main Roads. Boundaries for internal use, aligned with Local Government Authority boundaries. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in shp, tab, fgdb, kmz, gpkg, xml. The portal shows 2024-01-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
